a_pending_approval_then_client_disconnec.observed: Turn stays inProgress, thread status active; app-server keeps the approval pending (no auto-decline). A client that later thread/resume's receives the SAME request id again immediately and may answer it; turn then completes.

b_queued_item_no_client.observed: thread/queue/add on an idle thread starts a turn at once; queue/add behind a running turn starts its own turn after it even when the queuing client unsubscribed+disconnected first. c_two_clients_same_thread.observed: Every subscribed client (TUI via --remote and script) receives the server request, including for turns the OTHER client started. The script answered (decline) a request of a TUI-started turn: accepted, serverRequest/resolved sent, TUI approval prompt disappeared. app-server enforces no turn ownership; first answer wins; serverRequest/resolved reaches all subscribers.
